params.nscore: src.nscore.nscore on Por (asserted == saved NPor, atol 1e-10)
params.lag_rule: lag_dist = mean nearest-neighbour distance of the cell's samples; lag_tol = 0.5 * lag_dist; nlag = floor(MAX_LAG_M / lag_dist) + 1 (gamv bin centres 0, lag_dist, ..., <= MAX_LAG_M); MAX_LAG_M = 0.5 * domain extent = 500.0 m; omnidirectional (atol=90, bandh=9999, azi=0); isill=1
params.npairs_note: npairs = distinct point pairs = gamv npp / 4 (ordered pairs x omni double count); gamv index 0 (self pairs) and empty bins dropped
params.fit_rule: single spherical structure, total sill fixed 1.0: gamma(h) = nug + (1 - nug) * Sph(h; range); nug in [0.0, 0.999], range in [lag_dist, 1000.0] m; lags with < 30 distinct pairs excluded; weighted least squares (scipy.optimize.least_squares, method='trf') with w_j = npairs_j / h_j^2 (gstat fit.method = 7, the gstat default); deterministic multi-start grid nug0 in [0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8] x range0 in geomspace(lag_dist, 1000.0, 6); lowest cost kept. fit_rmse = unweighted RMSE over used lags.

fit.weights: w_j = npairs_j / h_j^2 (gstat fit.method = 7, the gstat default)
